promptTemplate: Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup. Edit target is the attached existing demo product photograph. Create ONE standalone transparent-background ecommerce product cutout on a square canvas. SUBJECT: {subject} Composition: complete product entirely within frame, centered with 8% clear margin all around; apparel shows natural structured volume with invisible mannequin technique and hollow necklines. Photograph the garment, never a human. Invariants: retain the supplied product design, existing marks and brand symbols, color, stitching, zipper placement and construction. Do not invent or add logos, words, labels or marks. Reconstruct only cropped hems or folded-away garment sections as necessary. No fake side or back view. Soft premium studio light, subtle realistic shadows within the garment, crisp matte textile/leather texture, natural proportions and folds. Remove only the old background. Avoid people, skin, faces, bodies, hands, visible mannequins, hangers, plastic, artificial gloss, extra clothes, text, watermark. Return actual transparent alpha. Concept demo photography.
